headline: EpiSEM-Bench tests evidence-dependent safety and useful recovery in tool agents
summary: The authors introduce EpiSEM-Bench, with 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs over six tool-use domains, fact-level omission of safety evidence and an optional recovery tool. In one reported evaluation of ten models, access to recovery reduced unsafe execution on matched conditions for every model; nine also improved permissible-task completion, while one declined slightly. These are author-reported synthetic-benchmark findings, not independent or live-system results.
